You're describing chest pain tied specifically to anxiety—that connection between your body and stress feels real in how you've put it together. From Jessica Lange's account of depression she mentioned, there are certainly people who experience physical symptoms alongside their mood states, though her description focused more on sadness and rage than acute chest sensations during anxious moments.

I'm reaching for a diagnosis from just these details—what I actually have is someone reporting somatic distress with emotional triggers. That could point toward several things: panic responses, muscle tension patterns, or yes, potentially depressive episodes manifesting physically—but also many other possibilities entirely. What matters most right now seems less like categorizing the pain and more about whether this pattern has changed your functioning enough to warrant medical attention.
